# add docker

Add the `docker` cask — Docker Desktop for Mac, the engine behind the `docker.bash` helpers and the `docker`/`docker-compose` oh-my-zsh plugins — to the Homebrew toolset. The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/docker).
